text:
ana: Quick prod update — rolled 'granule-batcher' + 'predictive-kv' to the text-gen canary (10%). Early: token cost ~-12%, p95 latency ~-18%, p50 up ~10%.

deploy-bot: deploy started: infra/serve@granule-batcher+predictive-kv -> canary (prod-gen-canary)

sre-bot: canary healthchecks: 5m OK, CPU stable, 1 pod restarted (OOM) — investigating

mike: sweet. which models/routes are in the canary?

ana: light/med seq routes: redwood-7b, rw-13b-quant, small-chat stack. long-seq heavy routes excluded.

olivia: any impact on p99 or errors?

ana: p99 mostly flat; small +4ms for seq>1024. mitigation: fallback for seq>2048 -> legacy packer (in canary config).

mike: rough $ savings if rolled to 100%?

ana: ~9% net monthly savings extrapolated. enabling batching density tweaks in next PR could add ~2-3%.

olivia: paste the local repro config?

ana: local repro: ./dev/run_infer.sh --model redwood-7b --seq 512 --qps 5 with overrides:
batcher.granule.max_size=48
batcher.granule.target_fill=0.82
kv.predictive.prefetch_ratio=0.6
fallback.seq_threshold=2048

ana: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/1829 — has benchmarks + flamegraphs.

sre-bot: incident note: pod OOM on startup due to aggressive slot alloc + a 48->64 bump on one host. pod restarted, no client errors.

ana: rolled a fix: cap batcher.granule.max_size=48 and added soft memory cap check; included in new rollout.

sam: please add a short blurb to release feed, tag eng-sre + devex, and add how-to in /docs/runtime/ops for fallback toggles.

ana: will do. planning full 100% roll in ~24h if no regressions; will post final summary then.

mike: two follow-ups: add p95 by model in PR, and perf tests for mixed short/long sessions?

ana: adding graphs and queuing mixed-session perf run now.

deploy-bot: canary -> 10% complete, last health window OK

olivia: :tada: nice cost/latency win — thanks team :)
